templates.pattern: Eight persons [P1]-[P8] sit in a circle, 4 face inward and 4 face outward alternately. [P1] faces inward and is 3rd to right of [P5] (outward). [P3] is 2nd to left of [P1] (both inward). [P7] faces outward and is opposite [P3]. [P2] is immediate right of [P7]. [P6] faces inward and is between [P4] (outward) and [P8] (outward). Who sits 3rd to the left of [P2]?
templates.explanation: Mixed inward/outward circle. Solving step by step: [P6] is 3rd to left of [P2] in the final arrangement

templates.pattern: Twelve persons [P1]-[P12] sit in two rows of 6. Row 1 faces north, Row 2 faces south. [P1] is 4th from left in Row 1. [P7] faces [P1]. [P3] is 2nd to right of [P1] in Row 1. [P9] is 2nd to left of [P7] in Row 2. [P5] is at the extreme right of Row 1. [P11] faces [P5]. [P2] is between [P1] and [P3]. [P8] faces [P2]. Who is at extreme left of Row 2?
templates.explanation: Row1: [P4]-[P1]-[P2]-[P3]-[P6]-[P5]. Row2(mirror): [P11]-[P7]-[P8]-[P9]-[P12]-[P10]→reversed. Extreme left of Row2 = [P10]

templates.pattern: Ten persons sit in two parallel rows of 5. Row X faces east (persons [P1]-[P5]). Row Y faces west (persons [P6]-[P10]). [P1] faces [P6]. [P3] is 3rd from left in Row X. [P8] is 2nd to right of [P6] in Row Y. [P4] is to immediate right of [P3]. [P2] faces [P8]. [P9] is 3rd from right in Row Y. [P5] is immediate right of [P4]. [P10] is immediate right of [P9]. Who faces [P5]?

Nine persons [P1]-[P9] sit around a circular table. Some face inward, some outward. [P1] faces outward and is 4th to right of [P9] who faces inward. [P2] faces inward and is 2nd to right of [P1]. [P5] faces outward and is opposite [P2]. [P3] and [P6] are immediate neighbours of [P5]. [P3] faces inward. [P4] is 3rd to left of [P9]. [P7] is between [P4] and [P6] going anticlockwise. [P8] is immediate right of [P9]. How many face inward?
templates.explanation: Solving 9-person mixed direction arrangement: 5 face inward ([P2],[P3],[P4],[P7],[P9])

templates.pattern: Six persons [P1]-[P6] are seated in a row. [P2] is to the right of [P5] but to the left of [P4]. [P1] is to the left of [P3] but to the right of [P6]. [P5] is to the left of [P1]. [P3] is to the left of [P4]. [P6] is not at the extreme left. Who is at position 4 from the left?
templates.explanation: Order derived: [P5]-[P6]-[P1]-[P2]-[P3]-[P4]. Position 4 = [P2]

templates.pattern: Eight persons [P1]-[P8] sit around a circular table facing inward. [P1] is 3rd to right of [P4]. [P2] is not adjacent to [P4] or [P1]. [P5] is 2nd to left of [P3]. [P3] is 4th to right of [P1]. [P6] is between [P4] and [P7] (going clockwise from [P4]). [P8] is immediate right of [P2]. What is the position of [P7] relative to [P2] going clockwise?
templates.explanation: Solving 8-person circular: [P7] is 3rd to right of [P2] going clockwise

templates.pattern: Seven persons [P1]-[P7] sit in a row. [P4] is 3 places to the right of [P7]. [P2] is 2 places to the left of [P5]. [P1] is to the immediate right of [P5] and to the immediate left of [P6]. [P3] is to the immediate left of [P7]. If [P4] is at position [A] from right, what position is [P3] from the left?
templates.explanation: Order: [P3]-[P7]-[P2]-[P5]-[P1]-[P6]-[P4]. [P3] is at position 1 from left

templates.pattern: Ten persons [P1]-[P10] sit in two rows of 5. Row A faces south. Row B faces north. [P1] is 3rd from right in Row A. [P6] faces [P1]. [P2] is immediate right of [P1] in Row A. [P7] is 2nd to left of [P6] in Row B. [P3] is 2nd to left of [P1] in Row A. [P8] faces [P3]. [P4] is at extreme right of Row A. [P5] is immediate left of [P3]. [P9] is immediate right of [P8]. [P10] faces [P4]. Who faces [P5]?
templates.explanation: RowA: [P5]-[P3]-[P1]-[P2]-[P4]. RowB mirror(facing): [P7]-[P8]-[P6]-[P9]-[P10]. [P5] faces [P7]

templates.pattern: Eight persons [P1]-[P8] sit around a circular table. [P1],[P3],[P5],[P7] face inward. [P2],[P4],[P6],[P8] face outward. They sit alternately. [P1] is 3rd to right of [P3]. [P6] is immediate right of [P1]. [P2] is 2nd to right of [P8]. [P5] is opposite [P2]. [P7] is immediate left of [P4]. Which two persons are immediate neighbours of [P8]?
templates.explanation: Alternating arrangement: circle = [P1]-[P2]-[P3]-[P4]-[P5]-[P6]-[P7]-[P8]. Solving: [P8] is between [P3] and [P4]... wait, between [P7] and [P1]. Neighbours = [P7] and [P1]

templates.pattern: Six persons [P1]-[P6] of different professions (Doctor, Engineer, Teacher, Lawyer, CA, Pilot) sit in a row. The Doctor is 3rd from left. The Engineer is to the immediate right of the Doctor. [P1] is the Lawyer and is at the extreme left. [P3] is the Pilot. [P3] is 2nd to right of [P5] who is the Teacher. [P4] is the CA. Who is the Doctor?
templates.explanation: Order: [P1(Lawyer)]-[P5(Teacher)]-[P6(Doctor)]-[P4(Eng)]-[P2]-[P3(Pilot)]. Doctor = [P6]

templates.pattern: Eight friends [P1]-[P8] sit around a circular table. [P1] is 4th to right of [P5]. [P8] is 3rd to left of [P5]. [P2] is between [P1] and [P8] (going clockwise from [P1]). [P3] is opposite [P2]. [P6] is 2nd to right of [P3]. [P7] is between [P5] and [P4] going clockwise. How many persons sit between [P6] and [P8] going anticlockwise?
templates.explanation: Solving 8-person circular: between [P6] and [P8] anticlockwise = 3 persons

templates.pattern: [N] persons sit in a row. [P1] is [A]th from left, [P2] is [B]th from right, [P3] is exactly between them. [P4] is [K] places to the right of [P3]. [P5] is [M] places to the left of [P4]. [P6] is to the immediate right of [P2]. What is [P6]'s rank from left?
templates.explanation: [P6] is immediate right of [P2]. [P2] from left = N-B+1. [P6] from left = N-B+2... but here [P6] is right, so pos = N-B+1+1 = N-B+2. Wait: from left = (N-B+1)+1 = N-B+2

templates.pattern: Seven persons [P1]-[P7] sit in a row. [P2] is 2nd to left of [P6]. [P4] is 3rd to right of [P7]. [P1] is between [P7] and [P2] with one person between [P1] and each. [P5] is to the immediate right of [P6]. [P3] is at extreme left. Who is at position 5 from right?
templates.explanation: Order: [P3]-[P7]-[P1]-[P2]-[P6]-[P5]-[P4]. Position 5 from right = position 3 from left = [P1]

templates.pattern: Ten persons [P1]-[P10] sit around a circular table. [P1] faces inward and is 4th to left of [P6] (outward). [P2] is opposite [P7]. [P3] faces inward and is 3rd to right of [P1]. [P5] is immediate right of [P6]. [P8] is 2nd to left of [P3]. [P4] is between [P9] and [P10] going clockwise. [P7] faces inward. [P9] faces outward. How many persons face outward?
templates.explanation: Solving 10-person mixed direction circular: 5 persons face outward

templates.pattern: Nine people sit in a 3x3 grid. Row1 (top): [P1],[P2],[P3] left to right. Row2 (mid): [P4],[P5],[P6]. Row3 (bot): [P7],[P8],[P9]. [P5] is in centre. [P1] is diagonally opposite [P9]. [P2] is directly above [P5]. [P4] is directly left of [P5]. [P6] is direct right of [P5]. Who is diagonally opposite [P3]?
templates.explanation: Grid: [P1][P2][P3] / [P4][P5][P6] / [P7][P8][P9]. Diagonally opposite [P3] (top-right) is [P7] (bottom-left)

templates.pattern: Eight persons [P1]-[P8] sit in a row. [P5] is 4th from left. [P3] is 3rd to right of [P5]. [P1] is 2nd to left of [P5]. [P2] is between [P1] and [P5] (adjacent to [P1]). [P7] is immediate right of [P3]. [P4] is between [P5] and [P3]. [P6] is at extreme left. [P8] is at extreme right. Who is 3rd from right?

Twelve persons sit in two rows of 6, facing each other. Row 1 faces north ([P1]-[P6]). Row 2 faces south ([P7]-[P12]). [P1] faces [P12]. [P3] is 3rd from left in Row1. [P9] is 2nd to right of [P12] in Row2. [P9] faces [P3]. [P2] is between [P1] and [P3]. [P8] faces [P2]. [P6] is extreme right of Row1. [P7] faces [P6]. [P4] is immediate right of [P3]. [P10] faces [P4]. [P5] is between [P4] and [P6]. [P11] faces [P5]. Who is at extreme right of Row 2?
templates.explanation: Row1: [P1]-[P2]-[P3]-[P4]-[P5]-[P6]. Row2 (faces north, mirror): [P7]-[P11]-[P10]-[P9]-[P8]-[P12]. Extreme right of Row2 = [P7]? Actually extreme right = [P12] since [P12] faces [P1] (extreme left of Row1). So extreme right of Row2 = [P12]... wait rows face each other so Row2 right = [P7]

templates.pattern: Six persons [P1]-[P6] with designations (Manager, Deputy, Assistant, Clerk, Peon, Director) sit around a circle. Director sits 2nd to right of Manager. [P1] is the Director. [P3] is 3rd to left of [P1]. [P3] is the Clerk. [P5] is opposite the Manager. Deputy is to the immediate right of Director. [P2] is the Deputy. [P4] sits between Peon and [P6]. [P4] is the Manager. Who is the Peon?
templates.explanation: Circle: [P4(Mgr)]-[P3(Clerk)]-[P5(Asst)]-[P1(Dir)]-[P2(Dep)]-[P6(Peon)]. Peon = [P6]

templates.pattern: [N] persons sit in a row. [P1] is [A]th from left. [P2] is [B]th from right. [P3] sits exactly midway between [P1] and [P2]. [P4] is [K] places to the right of [P3]. [P5] is [M] places to the left of [P1]. If [P5] is at the extreme left, find total persons.
templates.explanation: If [P5] extreme left, A-M=1 so M=A-1. Total = A+B-1 (from P3 logic). Actually total = A+B-1 when derived from midpoint = (A + N-B+1)/2

templates.pattern: Eight persons [P1]-[P8] sit in a circle. [P1],[P3],[P5],[P7] are males. [P2],[P4],[P6],[P8] are females. No two males or females are adjacent. [P1] is 2nd to right of [P4]. [P3] is opposite [P8]. [P6] is immediate right of [P3]. [P5] is 3rd to right of [P2]. [P7] is between [P4] and [P6]. Who is opposite [P1]?
templates.explanation: Alternating M-F circle. Solving: [P1] opposite = [P5]

templates.pattern: Seven persons [P1]-[P7] in a row. [P1] is not adjacent to [P4] or [P6]. [P2] is 3rd from right. [P3] is 2nd to left of [P7]. [P7] is at extreme right. [P4] is to the immediate right of [P5]. [P6] is between [P1] and [P3]. [P1] is to the left of [P3]. What is [P5]'s position from the left?
templates.explanation: Order: [P5]-[P4]-[P1]-[P6]-[P3]-[P2]-[P7]. [P5] is at position 1 from left

templates.pattern: Five married couples sit around a circular table. No husband sits next to his wife. [P1] is husband of [P2]. [P3] is husband of [P4]. [P5] is husband of [P6]. [P7] is husband of [P8]. [P9] is husband of [P10]. [P1] is 3rd to right of [P4]. [P6] is opposite [P1]. [P3] is immediate right of [P6]. [P8] is 2nd to right of [P3]. Who is to the immediate left of [P10]?
templates.explanation: 10-person circle with couple constraints. Solving arrangement: immediate left of [P10] = [P5]

templates.pattern: Eight persons [P1]-[P8] sit in a row. [P1] is 5th from right. [P2] is 3rd to right of [P8]. [P8] is at extreme left. [P3] is to the immediate left of [P1]. [P4] is between [P2] and [P3] with no one between [P4] and [P2]. [P5] is at extreme right. [P6] is 2nd to left of [P5]. [P7] is between [P1] and [P5]. Who is 4th from left?

Six persons [P1]-[P6] sit at a rectangular table: 2 on longer sides (3 each) and none at ends. [P1] and [P4] sit on same side, [P4] in middle. [P2] is directly opposite [P4]. [P5] is to the immediate right of [P1] (same side). [P6] is to the left of [P2] (opposite side). [P3] is between [P5] and another person. Who sits directly opposite [P1]?
templates.explanation: Side1: [P1]-[P4]-[P5]. Side2 (opposite): [P6]-[P2]-[P3]. [P1] is directly opposite [P6]

templates.pattern: Nine persons [P1]-[P9] are in a queue. [P1] is [A]th from front. [P9] is [B]th from back. [P5] is exactly midway between [P1] and [P9]. [P3] is [K] places behind [P5]. [P7] is [M] places ahead of [P3]. [P2] is immediately behind [P7]. If total queue = [N], what is [P2]'s position from the back?
templates.explanation: [P5] pos = (A + N-B+1)/2. [P3] = P5+K. [P7] = P3-M. [P2] = P7+1. From back = N-P2_from_front+1
